messages:
Cal: Canaryed q-onboard-int4 this morning. Perf looks great but we're seeing a localized regression on the "entropy-holdouts" promptset — summaries gain invented percentages and drop a key step.
Jo: Can you paste a small redacted example and the eval deltas?
Cal: Example (redacted):
```
Input: customer support thread ~800 tokens
Gold: 3 action bullets, no invented numbers
q-int8-baseline: correct bullets
q-int4-canary: includes a bogus "65%" stat and omits bullet #2
```
Cal: Batch deltas vs int8: ROUGE-L -2.4, F1 -1.9, hallucination +0.11. Failures clustered when effective KV-cache >45k and repeated entity mentions occur.
Aria: We did a seedbank consolidation yesterday and also flipped the int4 fused-softmax path in runtime. Could be provenance mismatch or numeric drift.
Jo: Two parallel actions: 1) provenance/dedupe sweep on entropy-holdouts (fuzzy threshold 0.8) + microgolden relabel 160 samples; 2) quant/kernel ablation: int4(fused-softmax), int4(legacy-softmax), int8 baseline on identical hardware.
Cal: Command for dedupe: `python infra/dedupe.py --in entropy-holdouts.json --t 0.80 --out dedup_3632109876.json`
label-bot: Created task LR-900 "int4 entropy-holdouts microgolden" 160 items, priority: high, ETA 36h. QA threshold recommended: 94%. :robot_face:
Aria: I'll run the ablation matrix now with flags `--legacy-softmax` and `--fp32-softmax` and gather diffs. If legacy-softmax recovers quality, it's a fused-softmax numeric issue.
Jo: Make sure to include anchor provenance for each sample in the relabel set so labelers can flag "provenance-mismatch" tags. If relabel aligns to baseline, we'll do a small golden refresh. If relabel still shows drift, rollback fused-softmax on canary.
Cal: ops-bot can we set a temporary routing rule: token_count>600 & turns>2 -> int8-canary to reduce user exposure?
ops-bot: Routing rule created: token_count>600 & turns>2 -> int8-canary. Enabled at 3632109950.
Aria: Running ablation across 3 nodes; posting table when done. Also exporting dedup list to internal gist.
Cal: Thanks. Labeling ops, please include an "invented-number" annotation and mark any samples where provenance changed after seedbank consolidation.
label-bot: Added QA tag "invented-number" and metadata field request for provenance to LR-900.
Jo: Plan looks good. Once we have relabel summary + ablation table we decide rollback vs golden refresh. Please @channel with the results. :white_check_mark:
